properties.name: The follow-through rule and the promotion detector read one "arrived": delivered requirements, how findings close, ChangeEvent and DesignRule targets
properties.rationale:
The finding (fact:root-cause-follow-through-reads-arrival-from-a-status-nothing-sets-and-misses-how-findings-close-2026-10-13) traced 20 of unresolved_setup's 47 findings to the arrival it read. It read a Requirement as arrived only at `met`, which no requirement carries; delivery is derived (report.rs, BL-104). It read a finding as acted on only through EVOLVES_INTO, while this design closes findings with INVALIDATES or a valid_to, answers them with MITIGATES and records what they led to with CAUSES or TRIGGERS. It also did not count ChangeEvent and DesignRule targets, which the promotion detector counted. The class: "arrived" was re-derived by hand in each detector, and the copies disagreed.

The correction moves the reading into one module. Both rules read it, and each rule's one extra clause is written beside it. Counting the union of both old lists literally was refused for two measured reasons. Promotion counting EVOLVES_INTO would have reported 5 chains of one idea becoming another as answered questions. Follow-through counting an accepted Requirement would break the pin an_accepted_requirement_is_a_need_agreed_not_a_need_met, and the brief's own test.

What moved, checked id by id: 5 delivered requirements, 13 acted-on findings (9 closed by INVALIDATES from a ChangeEvent, two of which also carry a valid_to; 1 answered by MITIGATES from an accepted Decision; 3 that led to a ChangeEvent, a Decision or a Requirement), 1 ChangeEvent and 1 DesignRule. One of the 5 had been acknowledged (decision:ack:heal:4b023a9e7da76757). Its own rationale said to withdraw it once the two requirements were accepted; they are now accepted and delivered, so it is withdrawn in this record. Promotion keeps all 9 of its findings and gains 4 ideas whose requirement is delivered while still reading proposed.

The 18 finding-to-finding links (C4) stay defects, by Anthony's conditional ruling. He agreed to treat such a link as precedent only if an unacted finding is reported elsewhere. Measured in code on 2026-10-13, it is not, in general: open_follow_ups lists only fact_type follow_up, and defect_overtaken_by_change fires only when a change is near. A test pins that they still raise. One of them is mitigated by a DesignRule; whether a rule in force answers a finding is left to the same ruling.

Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: New crates/reflow2-core/src/arrival.rs is the one answer to "has this node arrived?". Decision: accepted. Capability, Component or Artifact: realized or verified. Requirement: met, or delivered by report.rs's requirement_is_delivered (reused, not copied), and never when dropped. Epoch: arrived. ChangeEvent and DesignRule: by existing. A finding counts when it is closed (a valid_to, or INVALIDATES from anything), answered (MITIGATES from an accepted Decision or a ChangeEvent), or led on (CAUSES or TRIGGERS into a Decision, ChangeEvent or Requirement, unless refuted or spurious). unresolved_setup (heal.rs) reads follows_through, meaning evolved or arrived; the hand-kept follow_through_exists is gone, and the message names the condition computed for the target's type. decision_overtaken_by_promotion (detect.rs) reads promotion_has_landed, meaning arrived or a Requirement the owner accepted; its own status list is gone. finding_is_closed now serves the three identical copies of "a finding is closed": open_follow_ups (report.rs), defect_overtaken_by_change (detect.rs) and the doubt catalogue (doubt.rs). schema/derived declarations follow the code. Measured on main's design copy (c58305ba8): unresolved_setup went from 47 to 27, and decision_overtaken_by_promotion from 9 to 13; no other defect or gap count moved.
